falseFriends.demand: 'Demanda' correctly means demand but also means 'lawsuit' in legal context
falseFriends.station: Use 'estação de trabalho' for workstation, not 'estação' alone (train station/season)
falseFriends.idle: Use 'inativo' or 'em espera', not 'ocioso' (can be pejorative)
falseFriends.billion: Brazilian Portuguese uses short scale (unlike European Portuguese): 'bilhão' = 10^9, same as English
falseFriends.setup: Use 'preparação' or 'tempo de preparação', not 'instalação' (software/physical installation)

grammarNotes.numberFormatting: Comma decimal, period thousands: '1.234,56'. Percentage: '85%' (no space).
grammarNotes.compoundTerms: Prepositional compounds: 'tempo de ciclo' (cycle time), 'perda de velocidade' (speed loss)
grammarNotes.refugoDistinction: 'Refugo' = production scrap (rejected units). 'Sucata' = scrap metal. Use 'refugo' for OEE quality.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: In prepositional compound phrases, the modifier noun after 'de' stays SINGULAR when naming a concept/category. CORRECT: 'causas de perda de velocidade' (causes of loss [sg] of speed). WRONG: 'causas das perdas de velocidade' (causes of-the losses [pl] of speed). The contracted article 'das' (de+as) signals incorrect pluralization of the modifier. Only the head noun takes plural.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE acronym is commonly used in Brazilian manufacturing. Full form: 'Eficiência Global dos Equipamentos'.
industryContext.regionalVariations: Brazilian Portuguese differs significantly from European Portuguese
industryContext.totvsERP: TOTVS (dominant Brazilian ERP) sets de facto Brazilian Portuguese manufacturing terminology.

commonMistakes: Using European Portuguese vocabulary instead of Brazilian
Using 'tu' form (not common in Brazilian professional contexts)
Using 'sucata' for production quality scrap instead of 'refugo'
Omitting cedilla and accents: 'produção', 'função' must retain diacritics

Pluralizing the modifier in compound noun phrases: 'causas das perdas de velocidade' (WRONG — 'das perdas' pluralizes the modifier) instead of 'causas de perda de velocidade' (CORRECT — 'perda' stays singular as it names the concept). Only the head noun should take plural
notes: OEE is commonly used; 'você' is standard; Brazilian spelling and vocabulary required. Target: Portuguese (Brazil). P95 expansion 2.22x.
